title: Birth in Vernon, Texas; mother, local orchestra and first trombone
summary: Born 1905 in Vernon, Texas; mother a piano teacher; he got a trombone at seven for the hometown brass band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, I was born over in Vernon, Texas, in 1905. That's a little town in the northern part of, northwestern part of Texas, near the Oklahoma border in Wilburga County.
Mm-hmm. And the exact date of your birth?
Uh, August the 20th, 1905. August the 20th. 1905. Yeah, I'm 54 years old.
Mm-hmm. And, uh, what kind of music do you remember hearing first over there?

Well, uh, my mother was a piano teacher, and, uh, the, one of the professors in town, uh, by the name of, uh, Paul Getze, late Paul Getze, uh, is a, he was a, a German-born, uh, professor, and very well schooled. And, uh, we had a little orchestra there, and we played light classics, of, uh, maybe, uh, type of humorous and, and, uh, barcarole and things like that. And then we had a, a little hometown brass band. It was always there to, uh, give a little, uh, outdoor concerts during the summer, and play for the county fair, and, uh, maybe sometime for a parade or something. And they needed a trombone in this, uh, little hometown band. So, when I was seven years old, they got me a trombone, and, uh, thought they could just raise one. So, I took up the trombone at the age of seven, and, uh, I've been playing trombone ever since.
